performance.title: Performance
performance.text: Don't accept slow systems as inevitable. Find where the bottleneck actually is before optimizing.

reliability.title: Reliability
reliability.text: Design for failure, observability, and recoverability — behavior should be predictable in production.

maintainability.title: Maintainability
maintainability.text: Code should still be understandable months after it was written, by me or by someone else.

simplicity.title: Simplicity
simplicity.text: Prefer the simplest architecture that genuinely meets the requirements — and no more.

observability.title: Observability
observability.text: A production system should tell you what is happening when something goes wrong.

tradeoffs.title: Trade-offs
tradeoffs.text: Every engineering decision has trade-offs. Choose deliberately based on the problem, constraints, and long-term impact.

strengthDescriptions.scalableBackend: Building maintainable backend services and APIs designed for scale.
strengthDescriptions.distributedSystems: Working with service-to-service communication, asynchronous workflows, and distributed architectures.
strengthDescriptions.microservices: Decomposing domains into independently deployable services with clear boundaries.
strengthDescriptions.apiDesign: Designing interfaces that are reliable, versionable, and developer-friendly.
strengthDescriptions.databaseOptimization: Optimizing queries, indexes, data access patterns, and database-heavy workloads.
strengthDescriptions.systemDesign: Thinking about scalability, failure modes, service boundaries, and long-term maintainability.
